tasks.instruction: Go to Taobao to purchase 'Stray Birds', sort the results by price from low to high, compare the options, select the 2 cheapest purchase methods, add them to the shopping cart, and finally stay on the shopping cart page.
rubrics: Searched for 'Stray Birds' (飞鸟集) on Taobao
Sorted the search results by price from low to high
Identified at least two valid items in the search results
Selected the two cheapest valid items
Added the first cheapest item to the shopping cart
Added the second cheapest item to the shopping cart
Navigated to the shopping cart page
human_reference_operations: select '价格从低到高' (Price from low to high)
tap on the first cheapest item to view details
tap on the second cheapest item to view details
tap on the shopping cart icon to navigate to the shopping cart page
